annotations.title: ICS / iCalendar Feed Sanitizer & Validator API

description: ICS / iCalendar Feed Sanitizer & Validator API: Repair broken .ics calendar feeds, normalize Windows timezones to IANA, and parse VEVENTs. (Endpoint: POST /v1/ics-sanitizer)

fix_inverted_dates.description: Swap DTSTART and DTEND when DTEND is earlier than DTSTART.

ics.description: Raw .ics (RFC 5545 iCalendar) text to validate, repair, and normalize.
ics.example:
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
BEGIN:VEVENT
SUMMARY:Sprint Review; Q4
DTSTART;TZID="Central European Standard Time":20261120T140000
DTEND;TZID="Central European Standard Time":20261120T130000
RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;COUNT=5;UNTIL=20261231T000000Z
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR

normalize_windows_timezones.description: Map proprietary Windows/Exchange TZIDs ('Central European Standard Time') to IANA timezones ('Europe/Budapest').

name: tinplate_ics_sanitizer
